notes.title: Shadows of Wyrmwood is Ready for Next Fest!
notes.content:
Steam Next Fest here we come!

Adventurers, the time has come! Shadows of Wyrmwood is launching into Steam Next Fest, bringing new features, balance updates, and bug fixes to enhance your journey.

New Features:

EventsRandom events now appear throughout your adventure. Some will aid you, while others will test your resolve. Be prepared for anything.
BlacksmithsBefore each dragon battle, a blacksmith appears. Choose one:

 Upgrade your gear
 Shop his wares
 Duel him for more loot

Balance Updates
Spells and enemies have been tuned for a more balanced and challenging experience.
Bug Fixes
Various small fixes to improve gameplay smoothness and stability.

The journey through Wyrmwood awaits. Join us in Next Fest and experience the adventure firsthand!

notes.title: Massive Update! 1/24
notes.content:
Big Balance Changes

Tailored Loot: Equipment is more likely to have a stat that you want 
Reduced Healing: Enemy healing was way higher than it should be, it has been lowered
Enemy Difficulty: Enemy power level and health has been reduced at lower difficulty levels


New Features

Keybinds: You can now use 1-4 to cast abilities and space to end turn, optional visual indicators


Bug Fixes

Buffs/Debuffs: some displays were incorrect
Tutorial Saving: tutorials now save correctly
Retry: retry at a ? node now correctly restarts combat


Let us know what you think in the comments, discussion boards or on our Discord!
